title: The Network Luncheon- Open to the Community
seo_title: The Network Luncheon in Springfield, MO – Dec 3, 2026
description: The Network Luncheon is a casual networking lunch where you eat a meal, meet local business, church, and community leaders, and hear a talk from a community member. This month's speaker is James E. Meadows of Carnahan Evans, whose legal practice focuses on business and real estate disputes. Anyone is welcome; it meets the first Thursday of each month, and this one is Thursday, December 3, 2026 at noon in the Chapel at Crosslines Community Outreach, 3055 E. Division St., Springfield, MO. Organizers ask you to respond to the Facebook event if you plan to attend.
